title: Avalanche — mother's prayer (Blues 9679 prototype)

characters.climber: a young man with short blonde hair and blue eyes in a black ski tracksuit
characters.mom: an older woman with grey hair and blue eyes in a maroon knit cardigan
characters.rescuer: a mountain rescuer with dark hair and brown eyes in a red rescue jacket
characters.prayer: a small warm glowing golden orb of light

world: Pixar-style 3D animated film, cinematic volumetric lighting, highly detailed, snowy mountain, consistent character design, no text or captions
shots: Sweeping aerial of a vast snowy mountain at dawn, soft pink light on the peaks, slow drift
Far below on the slope, a tiny lone figure climbs a snowy ridge, dwarfed by the mountain, slow push-in
Closer: a young man with short blonde hair and blue eyes in a black ski tracksuit plants an ice axe in the snow, cold breath misting, slow tilt up
Extreme close-up of the blonde young man's frosted face and blue eyes, determined, snowflakes drifting, gentle push-in
The young man in the black ski tracksuit stands on the ridge gazing up at the towering summit, small against the huge peak, slow zoom out
A cozy lamplit living room: an older woman with grey hair and blue eyes in a maroon cardigan watches a TV showing the snowy mountain on the news, worried, slow push-in
Close on the grey-haired mother's face, eyes gently closing, hands clasped to her chest in prayer, warm light, slow push-in
A small warm golden orb of light rises softly from the praying mother's chest, glowing in the dim room, slow lift
The golden orb of light floats out through the window into the night sky trailing sparkles, slow follow
High on the mountain a long crack races silently across the snowfield above, ominous, slow push
A towering tall wall of snow, an avalanche, roars down the mountainside, immense and powerful, wide slow shot
The blonde young man in the black tracksuit turns and sees the wall of snow coming, tiny beneath it, frozen still
The young man dives behind a large dark rock and curls down bracing as the snow hits, slow motion
Whiteout: churning snow engulfs the whole frame, swirling, slow
Darkness under the snow, the young man's face lit faint blue, eyes open, packed tight in snow, still, slow push-in
The young man's gloved hand presses weakly against the dense snow above him, no give, slow close-up
Far above, the golden orb of light streaks across the night sky over jagged moonlit peaks, slow aerial follow
The orb of light climbs higher toward a faint warm glow on the horizon where the sun will rise, vast sky, slow drift
Under the snow, a faint warm glow flickers inside the young man's chest, fragile, slow push-in
The young man's blue eyes half-closed, a single frozen tear, strength fading, slow close-up
Wide of the silent white mountain face, no sign of life, cold and still, slow drift
Tiny rescuers in red jackets appear far up the slope with poles, searching, distant, slow push
A rescuer with dark hair and brown eyes in a red rescue jacket scans the snow, breath fogging, slow pan
Under the snow the young man's hand falls still, the inner glow dimming toward dark, slow
The golden orb of light reaches the rising sun and circles it like a fairy, blazing gold, slow orbit
The sun swells with warm golden light, radiant rays spreading across the whole white mountain, slow radiant push
Golden sunlight pours over the snow slope, the cold world turning warm, slow sweep
Under the snow, near-total darkness, the young man's faint face almost gone, held still
A ski pole punches down through the snow from above and a needle of golden sunlight breaks in, slow impact
The thin beam of sunlight touches the young man's face in the dark and his blue eyes flicker open, slow push-in
The young man's hand reaches up toward the small hole of light above him, straining, low angle, slow
Above, the dark-haired brown-eyed rescuer in the red jacket drops to his knees and digs fast with both hands, slow push
More red-jacketed rescuers gather and dig, snow flying, warm golden light around them, slow wide
The hole widens and sunlight floods down onto the young man's face and black tracksuit, relief, slow push-in
The rescuer's hand clasps the young man's hand and pulls, golden light glowing behind them, slow close-up
The blonde young man is lifted out of the snow into full sunlight, gasping, alive, slow rise
The young man lies in bright snow under the warm sun breathing, blue sky above, slow overhead drift
The small golden orb of light gently descends from the sun and settles warmly over the young man, slow lower
Back home, the grey-haired mother in the maroon cardigan opens her eyes with a tear and a soft smile, warm light, slow push-in
Final wide: the sunlit snowy mountain at peace under a golden dawn, tiny safe figures on the slope, slow pull-back
